title: yaks edge keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/edge adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `relation` names a relation: an entity carrying it, beside `edge{from,to}`, is a link of that kind — a `cites` component beside `edge{from,to}` means this post cites that one. Which relations exist is for the application to declare, and this keyword is how it declares them.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [edgeKeywords]).

edge.description: This component, stored beside an `edge` component, names the kind of link. `true` names the relation after the component itself (a `cites` component is the `cites` relation); a string gives it a different name in queries, for a vocabulary that stores `references` but queries it as `referenced`. The keyword is named after the component it accompanies, so one rule covers them all — a component stored beside a key declares `key`.

relation.description: The older name for `edge`, meaning exactly the same thing. A vocabulary written with `relation: true` still loads unchanged; new ones use `edge: true`.
